params.prompt: A vertical photograph from a drone 1,500 feet above the farmland north of a small Pacific Northwest town at blue hour, looking south-southeast: Mount Rainier fills the upper third of the frame, huge, its north face holding the last pink alpenglow against a deep clean blue sky; the town's street grid and rooftops with warm streetlights just coming on run across the middle; dark evergreen forest and flat fields fill the lower third. Use the first attached image for the exact profile of Mount Rainier's north face and the second attached image for the layout of the town's street grid and the fields around it. Photoreal, crisp, full-frame camera at 35 mm, long exposure, no motion blur; the middle of the frame is calm low-contrast rooftops with nothing distinctive there; no people, no text, no logos, no signs, no vehicles near the camera.
